text.en:
Creation of Barangay Batucan. - The sitio of
Batucan is hereby separated from Barangay del Monte in
the Municipality of Talacogon, Province of Agusan del Sur
and constituted as a distinct and independent barangay to be
known as Barangay Batucan.

Territorial Boundaries. - The territorial
boundaries of Barangay Batucan are hereby described

DESCRIPTION

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. - The
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on
Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Provincial Ordinance No. 10,
Series of 1996 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the
Province of Agusan del Sur, which ratified the creation of
Barangay Batucan as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of
Canvassers on February 28, 1998, shall serve as substantial
compliance with the plebiscite requirement under Section 10
of the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
elected barangay officials of Barangay Batucan shall continue
to hold office until such time that their successors have been
duly elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities. - All public
infrastructure and facilities existing therein at the time of the
approval of this Act are hereby transferred without cost or

3
compensation to and shall be administered by the new
Barangay Batucan.

Internal Revenue Allotment Shares. -
Batucan shall be entitled to internal revenue allotment (IRA)
shares pursuant to Section 285 of the Local Government
Code of 1991, as amended.

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15)
days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper
of general circulation.
